'''Sheldon James Press''' (February 4, 1931 – November 25, 2020) was an American [[statistician]].

== Life and career ==
Press was born in [[Brooklyn, New York]]. He moved to [[California]] in 1951. He attended the [[University of Southern California]], earning his [[master's degree]] in [[mathematics]]. He also attended [[Stanford University]], earning his [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD degree]] in [[statistics]] in 1964.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://senate.universityofcalifornia.edu/in-memoriam/files/james-press.html|title=S. James Press|work=[[University of California|Academic Senate]]|access-date=July 30, 2026}}</ref>

Press served as a professor in the department of [[statistics]] at the [[University of California, Riverside]] until 2005. During his years as a professor, he was named a [[distinguished professor]],<ref name="a">{{Cite web|url=https://cnas.ucr.edu/news/2021/07/01/remembering-s-james-press-distinguished-professor-statistics-emeritus |title=Remembering S. James Press, Distinguished Professor of Statistics, Emeritus|work=[[University of California, Riverside]]|date=July 1, 2021|access-date=July 30, 2026}}</ref> and in 1981, he was named a [[Fellow of the American Association for the Advancement of Science|fellow]] of the [[American Association for the Advancement of Science]].<ref>{{Cite web|url= https://www.aaas.org/fellows/historic?field_last_name_value=All&field_address_city=All&field_address_when_elected_administrative_area=All&field_address_when_elected_country_code=All&field_year_elected=&field_primary_aaas_section=All&field_status_value=All&field_year_status_changed_value=&name_combine=Press&field_institutional_affiliation_value=|title=Historic Fellows|work=[[American Association for the Advancement of Science]]|access-date=July 30, 2026}}</ref>

== Death ==
Press died on November 25, 2020, at the age of 89.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://imstat.org/2021/08/31/obituary-s-james-jim-press-1931-2020/|title=Obituary: S. James (Jim) Press 1931–2020|work=[[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]]|date=August 31, 2021|access-date=July 30, 2026}}</ref>
